summary: Assess whether a revenue forecast has a governed and validated model dependency.
description: Use the current business-pulse observation only as bounded input evidence and stop unless an exact approved forecast model, lineage, evaluation, expiry, and safe horizon are available.

guide.title: Revenue forecast readiness
guide.applicability: Use to determine whether current observations and an exact validated model are sufficient for a bounded forecast; without that model the result is a gap only.
steps: Verify the business-pulse capability and preserve its completeness and data-quality limits.
Resolve the exact model URI and verify trusted distribution, lineage, evaluation, approval, expiry, and safe horizon.
Stop with a model gap when any model requirement is absent; do not estimate a replacement with prompt reasoning.
When a future approved model exists, distinguish observed inputs, scenario assumptions, estimates, and validation limits.
guide.context_boundary: Narrative plans and vendor examples are not model artifacts, validation evidence, forecast inputs, or authorization to publish a prediction.
